title: Daily Brain
description: Three new brain puzzles every day, the same for everyone: Estimate (five quick guesses by feel, with tips on how to judge better), Picture Logic (a 10 × 10 nonogram) and Patterns (five number sequences). Your first try counts toward a public daily leaderboard, plus a streak, a shareable result and endless practice.
controls: Drag the slider, tap squares to fill (or mark them empty), and type answers on the number pad. Keyboard works too.
requirements: Any modern browser. The leaderboard needs an internet connection.
